publication_override.reason: The owner made publishing validated versions without device testing a standing rule.
publication_override.scope: installation and use on the owner's own Windows computer

not_validated: No person has installed or used 2.0.1 on a real Windows PC; only the GitHub windows-latest runner installed it silently, ran --smoke and the start-up probe, and uninstalled it.
The Canvas fill and cover sharpness were seen only in host renders at 2560x1440 (100 % and 150 %), not on a real screen; the cover size patterns of each source are unit-tested only.
Sync of recently played, statistics, Discord choice and playlists with a real phone on one account was not tried; phones on 9.1.0 or older do not send their listening.
The new Ketmix choices were not heard on real music.
Emoji rendering of playlist names in the Windows font was not checked on a real machine.
The MSI is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will warn about an unknown publisher.
known_limitations: No light/dark/system theme choice on Windows: the window follows Windows.
The phone is only reachable for phone control while its app is open or playing.

features_2_0_1.canvas: the Canvas covers its column edge to edge in the full player, F11 player, album header and Home hero (owner's player framing, else top-anchored crop), column width from the Canvas shape, decoded at the area's real pixels in 360-3840 steps with bicubic/Mitchell scaling, cover then poster then video fade-in
features_2_0_1.covers: CoverUrls sizes each source's artwork to display size x screen scale with fallback to the original; 384 MB disk cache; retries at 0/2/6/20/60 s; override rules of the phone (track, album, found, catalogue); playlist own cover or 2x2 mosaic, never the grey placeholder
features_2_0_1.studio_content: MediaOverrides and ArtworkRepo initialised before the session restores; refresh every 15 min, every 2 min while in use, on focus and when the full player opens; the current and next two Canvas fetched again after a publication; read-only for listener accounts
features_2_0_1.sync: recently played and statistics (per-device counters summed, each play counted once), Discord share choice and per-device link state, playlists with covers and emoji names
features_2_0_1.ketmix: echo rare (3.5-4.5 % of automatic transitions), titles stopping at full level mixed out at their last phrase, fade/bass swap/echo click fixes, live mix view removed, ratings kept in the Ketmix tab and the toast
